messages.title: 标题
messages.capacity_unknown: 未知；排程按无容量上限处理
messages.workload_note: 任务工作量为粗略估算；T+N 表示相对位置，不换算为小时、工作日或实际工期。普通任务条长表示工作量；阻塞任务的整行条纹只表示状态。
messages.scheduling_note: 排程使用输入任务顺序作为稳定优先级，依赖在前置任务结束时释放；结果是确定性的列表调度，不保证全局最优。
messages.chart_desc: {title}。条长表示粗略相对工作量，横轴只表示抽象相对顺序，不对应现实时间；阻塞任务没有虚构相对偏移。
messages.chart_caption: 工作量单位：{unit} · 条长=粗略工作量
messages.axis_caption: 横轴=相对位置 · 不代表实际工期
messages.blocked_count: {count} 个任务因外部条件待确认而阻塞
messages.arrow_note: 箭头表示依赖关系；依赖在前置任务完成后才释放。
messages.completion_blocked: 可排程相对终点 {finish}，整体相对终点未知

unit.evidence: EN “relative work units” (en.json:2) and 中文“相对工作单位” (zh-CN.json:2) both define a relative work unit; neither denotes elapsed time.

none.evidence: EN “None” and 中文“无” both mark absence. The renderer uses this for empty lists and missing optional values, not for numeric zero.

list_separator.evidence: EN comma-space and 中文顿号 differ only in locale punctuation; each joins the same ordered item list.

no_description.evidence: EN “No description” and 中文“无描述” both state that a task description is absent; the key is used as the empty task-description placeholder.

no_deliverable.evidence: EN “No deliverable description” and 中文“无交付物描述” both identify missing deliverable detail, matching the SVG row fallback.

plan_title.evidence: EN “Project plan” and 中文“项目计划” are equivalent top-level plan headings.

title.evidence: EN “Title” and 中文“标题” label the plan title field without changing the user-provided title.

summary.evidence: EN “Summary” and 中文“摘要” label the plan summary field.

workload_unit.evidence: EN “Workload unit” and 中文“工作量单位” both identify the unit assigned to workload.

capacity.evidence: EN “Parallel capacity” and 中文“并行容量” both refer to the task parallelism limit, not workload or total project size.

capacity_unknown.evidence: EN says capacity is unknown and scheduling proceeds without a capacity limit; 中文“未知；排程按无容量上限处理” preserves both clauses.

capacity_unknown_short.evidence: EN “Unknown (unbounded scheduling)” and 中文“未知（按无上限排程）” retain the unknown value and unbounded-scheduling qualification.

workload_note.evidence: Both full notes call workload approximate, define T+N as relative rather than hours/workdays/elapsed duration, map bar length to workload, and say full-row hatching indicates only blocked status.

scheduling_note.evidence: Both sentences use input task order as stable priority, release dependencies after predecessor work ends, describe deterministic list scheduling, and disclaim a global optimum.

assumptions.evidence: EN “Assumptions” and 中文“假设” are equivalent section headings for plan assumptions.

risks.evidence: EN “Risks” and 中文“风险” are equivalent risk-section headings.

requirements.evidence: EN plural “Requirements” and 中文“需求” both label the collection of requirements; Chinese does not encode number morphologically.

requirement.evidence: EN singular “Requirement” and 中文“需求” both label one requirement in the mapping table.

source.evidence: EN “Source” and 中文“来源” both label the provenance/source field of a requirement.

coverage.evidence: EN “Covering tasks” and 中文“覆盖任务” both identify tasks that cover a requirement, not requirements covered by a task.

requirement_mapping.evidence: EN “Requirement mapping” and 中文“需求映射” both name the requirement-to-task correspondence section.

schedule.evidence: EN “Relative workload schedule” and 中文“相对工作量排程” both make the schedule relative and workload-based.

task.evidence: EN “Task” and 中文“任务” are equivalent row/section labels.

type.evidence: EN “Type” and 中文“类型” both label the task-kind column.

start.evidence: EN “Relative start” and 中文“相对起点” preserve a relative start coordinate, not a calendar start date.

finish.evidence: EN “Relative finish” and 中文“相对终点” preserve a relative endpoint, not a calendar end date.

workload.evidence: EN “Workload” and 中文“工作量” both name the amount represented by task bars and the schedule column.

dependencies.evidence: EN “Dependencies” and 中文“依赖” both label predecessor relationships.

resources.evidence: EN “Resources” and 中文“资源” both label the resources assigned to a task.

status.evidence: EN “Status” and 中文“状态” both label the state field without altering the underlying status value.

task_details.evidence: EN “Task details” and 中文“任务详情” both head the per-task detail section.

description.evidence: EN “Description” and 中文“描述” are equivalent detail-field labels.

deliverable.evidence: EN “Deliverable” and 中文“交付物” identify what the task produces.

acceptance.evidence: EN “Acceptance criteria” and 中文“验收标准” both mean the criteria for accepting task completion.

pr_scope.evidence: EN “PR scope” and 中文“PR 边界” both label the task’s pull-request scope.

estimate_basis.evidence: EN “Estimate basis” and 中文“估算依据” both identify the rationale behind the estimate.

resource_locks.evidence: EN “Resource locks” and 中文“资源锁” both identify locked resources; Chinese/Japanese-style lack of plural marking does not change the set.

scheduled.evidence: EN “Scheduled” and 中文“已排程” are human-readable labels for the scheduled state; neither changes the protocol value.

blocked.evidence: EN “Blocked” and 中文“阻塞” are labels for the blocked state, distinct from scheduled.

blocked_reason.evidence: Both state that the task is blocked because external readiness is unknown/pending confirmation and preserve the {items} list of blockers.

chart_title.evidence: EN “Project Gantt chart” and 中文“项目甘特图” both title the same chart.

chart_desc.evidence: Both descriptions say bar length is approximate relative workload, the axis is abstract relative order rather than calendar time, and blocked tasks receive no invented relative offset.

chart_caption.evidence: Both show the workload unit via {unit} and explain that bar length is approximate workload.

axis_caption.evidence: Both distinguish a relative-position axis from actual duration; “no calendar duration” and “不代表实际工期” convey the same limit.

legend_task.evidence: Both identify a task mark and explain that its bar length denotes workload; the legend makes no stronger precision claim.

legend_milestone.evidence: EN “Milestone” and 中文“里程碑” name the same milestone category.

legend_external.evidence: EN “External item” and 中文“外部项” name an external item without conflating it with a task or milestone.

legend_blocked.evidence: Both identify blocked state and specify row background as its visual encoding.

blocked_label.evidence: Both label a blocked task, attribute it to unknown/pending external readiness, and retain {items}.

blocked_count.evidence: Both report {count} tasks blocked because external readiness is unknown/pending confirmation.

schedule_span.evidence: Both report a relative schedule span and retain {finish} as its endpoint.

arrow_note.evidence: EN leaves the completing task implicit; 中文 specifies the predecessor. This is compatible, not contradictory: the renderer draws the dependency arrow from the predecessor finish, and scheduling_note names predecessor completion.

empty_requirements.evidence: EN “No requirements” and 中文“无需求” both state that the requirements table is empty.

close.evidence: EN “Close” and 中文“关闭” are equivalent dialog-button actions.

completion_blocked.evidence: Both distinguish the schedulable portion’s relative finish {finish} from an unknown overall relative finish; neither claims the whole plan is complete.

completion.evidence: Both report only a relative finish {finish}, without implying calendar duration.

kind_task.evidence: EN “Task” and 中文“任务” correctly label the task kind in the detail display.

kind_milestone.evidence: EN “Milestone” and 中文“里程碑” correctly label the milestone kind.

kind_external.evidence: EN “External item” and 中文“外部项” correctly label the external-item kind.
